intro.t: When disaster hits, *Pete's crew shows up.*
intro.text: Peter D'Allessandro founded Disaster Cleanup Services in 2011, and it's still family-owned and run out of Bohemia. Pete started in 2005, traveling the country to help towns recover from hurricanes and floods, and his crews worked Hurricanes Irene and Sandy right here on Long Island. Today the team handles water damage, mold remediation, fire and smoke cleanup, waterproofing and the rebuild, for homes and businesses, around the clock.
intro.quote: We had a water leak in our office and Pete responded incredibly fast. Professional, efficient, and reliable.

items.h: Water moves fast. So do they.
items.d: Burst pipes, flooded basements and sewage backups: emergency extraction, structural drying and full restoration.
Mold remediation and air quality restoration by a NYS licensed mold remediation contractor, including crawl spaces and black mold.
Emergency board-up, smoke and soot cleanup, then the reconstruction.
Basement and crawl space waterproofing, including foundation and interior drainage work, so water stays out.
After the cleanup they handle the reconstruction too, so you aren't juggling contractors.

advantage.text: Emergency cleanup, drying, mold work and the rebuild, handled by the same family-owned company. They work directly with the major insurance carriers to make your claim simpler.

reviews.text: 30 five-star Google reviews and counting. Had DCS help you through a tough day? Your review helps the next neighbor know who to call.

faq: Yes. Disaster Cleanup Services offers 24/7 emergency response. Call the emergency line, 1-800-297-9283, any time. For everything else, the local office line is 631-573-6300.
Are they licensed for mold work?
Yes. They hold a New York State Department of Labor Mold Remediation Contractor License (26-6Z16G-SHMO), valid through April 2028.
Will they work with my insurance?
Yes. They work directly with the major insurance carriers to simplify your claim.
Their shop is at 1556 Ocean Ave in Bohemia, and they serve Long Island and the NYC metro area.
Do they do the repairs too?
Yes. They handle the emergency cleanup, then the reconstruction, so one team takes it start to finish.
